theme: An open day — clear the past-due travel bookings.
greeting: The calendar's nearly empty today, Dan — just the 9 o'clock behind you. With the girls at Jen's through midweek, it's a clean window to knock out the travel bookings that have slipped past due.

needsAttention.title: December break — decide and book
needsAttention.detail: Your own book-by date for the Dec 13–Jan 2 trip with all four kids is tomorrow, Oct 15. Holiday inventory for six over three weeks is the thinnest of the year, so settle the domestic-vs-international call first, then book.

needsAttention.title: Book the Maine Christmas rental
needsAttention.detail: A refundable full-size SUV out of Portland for Christmas week is the item flagged most likely to bite — thin holiday inventory that sells out. It's been marked 'book this week' since mid-September.

needsAttention.title: Drive the Pathfinder south
needsAttention.detail: The Oct 5–18 off-week gap to drive the Pathfinder from Portland to St Pete closes in a few days; miss it and it's another rental cycle. Book the one hotel night once the dates are set.

flagged.title: Morgan Stanley account funding
flagged.detail: A 'final reminder' to fund your new Signature Savings account arrived this evening — worth a glance to see if the deadline is real.

inbox.noise: Otherwise just a couple of automated updates.
inbox.clear: Nothing else is awaiting your reply.

resolved.title: Maine ferry tickets confirmed
resolved.detail: The order came through Oct 12 and you forwarded it to Mike — nothing more to do.

recipe.why: Autumn's chestnuts and winter squash are at their peak right now, worth the slow braise.
